prompt: A brick tunnel with faded teal mosaics, the camera behind the shoulder of a Black upright bass player of about 60, tall and white-haired, who is a soft dark shape along the left edge only, his white hair and the instrument's scroll just catching light. Beyond him at 50mm the singer faces us square on, face a third of the frame high and sharp, mouth open, a period car headlamp from the right lighting him warm amber against the teal. Behind the singer a stopped black sedan pours smoke from its bonnet, a lick of flame under the hinge. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
